title: LeagueRunRecordV2
description: What one generation of a population run played (ADR-021 sections 2 and 8, ADR-010 erratum A3 LE.5), beside LeagueRunRecord version 1, which a single-lineage run keeps writing: a new version because the root no longer has one frozen pair. COUNTING RULE. Every game has at least one learning seat (a member or an exploiter seat). A member entry counts every game in which that member holds at least one seat: games, played and forfeits (played + forfeits = games), with opponents per opponent id summing to games and played. A game between two members (m vs m, m vs x) appears in BOTH entries, under each other's member id; a self-play game appears once in the member's entry with the member's own id as opponent. episodes counts the Episodes of the member's OWN seats: one per played game, two per played self-play game (episodes = played + played self-play games). The root totals count DISTINCT games, as version 1 does (episodes = 2 * played, both seats of a game are written): root games = the sum of the members' games minus the games between two members, counted once per pair. The forfeit causes of a member are those of its games; the root causes count distinct games. copy_decision_hash names that generation's copy decision (null when none was taken). Written next to the generation's Episodes and referenced only by the SHA-256 of its JCS bytes. The reader rules the profile cannot say (no arithmetic, no uniqueItems) are checked by both readers, which also tie the record to its TrainingRunConfig: run key, hash and the numbers of members and exploiters.

run_id.description: The league run key (TrainingRunConfig.seeds.run_key), as each Episode's collection record names the run.

run_config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the run's TrainingRunConfig JCS bytes (runConfigHash).

generation.description: The generation the record covers, counted from 1.

seed_derivation.description: The version of the derivation of every battle seed, team draw and baseline stream from (run_id, generation, game index): SHA-256 over the JCS of those fields. A different byte layout is a different version.

plan_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the generation's match plan (plan.json): the plan's identity.

games.description: Distinct games in the plan (see the counting rule).

played.description: Distinct games played to an end. played + forfeits = games.

forfeits.description: Distinct games a policy forfeited: no Episodes, not training data.

forfeit_causes.description: Forfeits of distinct games by cause, sorted by cause, each cause once, each count at least 1; the counts sum to forfeits; present exactly when forfeits is above 0. Each cause is one some member has, and its count is at least the largest member count and at most the sum over the members.

episodes.description: Episodes written: two per played game, both seats.

copy_decision_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of that generation's copy decision, or null when none was taken.

members.description: One entry per learning member and exploiter seat, sorted (m<k> by k, then x<k> by k), each once.

Member.description: One learning member (m<k>) or exploiter seat (x<k>): its frozen pair at the start of the generation and the counts of the games in which it holds at least one seat (see the root counting rule). Reader rules: members sorted and unique; played + forfeits = games; opponents sorted by (opponent_policy_id, member) and unique, their games and played summing to the member's; episodes = played + the played self-play games; an opponent entry that names a member has that member's pair_policy_id, and the two members' entries about each other agree in games and played; forfeit_causes present exactly when forfeits is above 0, sorted, unique and summing to forfeits; baselines as in version 1 against the member's opponents.

member.description: m<k> for learning member k, x<k> for exploiter seat k, k counted from 0 without leading zeros.

pair_policy_id.description: The member's frozen pair's behaviour_policy_id, policy: plus a SHA-256.

games.description: Games in which this member holds at least one seat.

played.description: Of those, games played to an end. played + forfeits = games.

forfeits.description: Of those, games a policy forfeited.

forfeit_causes.description: Forfeits of this member's games by cause, sorted by cause, each once, each count at least 1; present exactly when forfeits is above 0; the counts sum to forfeits.

episodes.description: Episodes of this member's own seats: one per played game, two per played self-play game.

opponents.description: Games per opponent, sorted by (opponent_policy_id, member) with an absent member first, each pair once; the games sum to games and the played counts to played.

baselines.description: The damage-aware baseline's identity and counts for this member's games (ADR-018 sections 4, 5, 7): one entry per policy id, sorted, each once; each entry's games equal the opponent entry of the same policy id. Absent when the member played no damage-aware baseline.

preview.description: The Preview network's checkpoint id (SHA-256 of its file).

BaselineRecord.description: One scripted baseline whose play depends on more than its policy id. games equals the opponent entry of the same policy id; counts are the sums over those games, all integers (reader rules: probe_runs and unsupported_queries do not exceed queries; preview_decisions plus scored_decisions do not exceed decisions).

identity_hash.description: The baseline identity hash (ADR-018 section 5): SHA-256 of the JCS of {baseline_config_hash, mechanics_config_hash, adapter_format, reader_sha256, version_manifest}. Games with another hash are another baseline; every game of a generation carries the same one.

games.description: Games the baseline played in the generation.

probe_runs.description: Probe runs actually made (queries not answered from a game's memo).

unsupported_queries.description: Queries the probe answered unsupported: scored 0, never approximated.

reader_fallbacks.description: Requests answered by the actor-rule candidate because the state reader flagged a line.

assumed_set_fallbacks.description: Requests answered by the actor-rule candidate because no legal assumed opponent set could be built.

epsilon_plays.description: Requests where epsilon_ppm made the baseline play a random candidate.

probe_refusals.description: Optional (a minor change within v1; absent means 0 and is written only when above 0): requests answered by the actor-rule candidate because the mechanics probe refused a query the baseline built (a declared state the engine does not take). A high rate means the baseline plays like actor-rule; never more than queries.

cause.description: Why the policy failed, as the harness classifies a forfeit (runner.ts ForfeitCause).

MemberOpponent.description: Games against one opponent. member is present when the opponent is a member or exploiter seat of this generation (this member itself for self-play), and then opponent_policy_id is that member's pair_policy_id; absent for a baseline, a past snapshot or any other pair.

opponent_policy_id.description: The opponent's policy id as the Episodes' collection records name it: the frozen pair itself (self-play) or a scripted baseline, <name>@<commit>.

member.description: The opponent member's id, m<k> or x<k>.

played.description: Of those games, the ones played to an end.
